author: Jillian Pikora
title: Two Women Seriously Injured In Dump Truck Crash At Coram Intersection - NewsBreak
text:
By Jillian Pikora ,
54 minutes ago The intersection of Patchogue-Mount Sinai and Pine roads where the crash happened. Photo Credit: Google Maps (Street View) The collision happened at the intersection of Patchogue-Mount Sinai and Pine roads at 3:37 p.m., according to Suffolk County Police.
A 39-year-old woman driving a 2007 Toyota was attempting to make a left turn from southbound Patchogue-Mount Sinai Road into the eastbound lanes of Pine Road when her vehicle collided with a northbound 2001 Peterbilt dump truck, police said.
The driver and her 37-year-old passenger were both transported to Stony Brook University Hospital with serious injuries, authorities said.
The 35-year-old dump truck driver was also taken to the same hospital with non-life-threatening injuries, police said.
Both vehicles were impounded for safety checks as detectives continue investigating the crash.
Anyone with information is asked to contact Suffolk County Police Sixth Squad detectives at 631-854-8652.
